gpu_timing.method: ProfileGPU captures during 32-sweep jobs to extend the measurement window. Same per-dispatch settings as latency test. Sum of PRT Surfel Irradiance Sweep passes in each captured frame only, excluding resolve/other rendering. Four captures with passes per mode; four without passes per mode. Different slots/sweeps, not a guaranteed worst-case GPU budget.

limitations: No local invalidation or spatial interpolation quality change; roughly 10.5% SH difference from path reference remains.
Geometry edits still clear published GI until completion; full-cache recalculation remains.
Held SH delays response to new light; no warm start, blending or temporal filter.
Larger submissions increase GPU cost in update frames; fixed work cap is not a millisecond budget.
One submission in flight; final SH CPU readback remains.
PC editor only; mobile/cooked behavior not validated.
